note: Counts derived from the data files by tools/build_data.py. Chapters must read these instead of typing numbers.

hops.wording: The loop has 11 stops, numbered hop 0 to hop 10. Hop 0 is where the cash starts and hop 10 is where the loop closes, so the money makes ten moves.

external.label: Outside cash
external.reader_text: Cash that comes from outside the loop: lenders, outside investors, end customers. It is still not free money: lenders and investors must be repaid or earn a return from future end-user spending.

recycled.label: Recycled cash
recycled.reader_text: Cash that started with a loop participant and returns to that participant or its customers, for example Nvidia equity in a customer that buys Nvidia systems.

promise.label: Promise (not cash)
promise.reader_text: Contracts, backlog, RPO, backstops, guarantees, warrants, leases, letters of intent, and equity purchases that only close on a condition (for example an IPO closing). NOT cash moved. Never added into cash totals.

mixed.label: Mixed round
mixed.reader_text: An aggregate round that contains both vendor money (recycled) and outside money (external). See money_split for the parts. Excluded from sums because the component edges are charted separately. Chapters should show the money_split parts (for example vendor money and other investors) and never the bare word "mixed".

outside_loop_investment.label: Stake outside the loop
outside_loop_investment.reader_text: Nvidia's own cash invested in a company that is not a customer in the AI-demand loop (for example Intel, Synopsys, Nokia). It is neither outside money entering the loop nor recycled customer money. Excluded from loop totals; shown on the Nvidia node as a separate line.

deal_line_sentence: 61 deal lines: 21 are cash inside the loop (equity or debt), 37 are promises, 1 is a mixed round holding both vendor and outside money, and 2 are stakes in companies outside the loop.
